info.title: Smart Warehouse API
info.description:
NextGen Warehouse backend — Flow 2: Warehouse structure (flat REST).

- **POST**: parent ID in body (`warehouseId`, `zoneId`, `rackId`, `rackLevelId`)
- **GET list**: parent ID in query
- **GET/PATCH/DELETE**: resource ID in path only

### Authentication & users
- `POST /api/auth/login` — public
- `POST /api/users` — Bearer token; hierarchy: SYSTEM_ADMIN → WH_ADMIN/TENANT_ADMIN; WH_ADMIN → WH_STAFF; TENANT_ADMIN → TENANT_STAFF

role.description: SYSTEM_ADMIN may create WH_ADMIN, TENANT_ADMIN. WH_ADMIN → WH_STAFF. TENANT_ADMIN → TENANT_STAFF.

warehouseId.description: Required when SYSTEM_ADMIN creates WH_ADMIN / WH_STAFF

tenantId.description: Required when SYSTEM_ADMIN creates TENANT_ADMIN / TENANT_STAFF

post.description: Returns JWT access token. Use header `Authorization: Bearer <token>` for protected routes.

get.description: SYSTEM_ADMIN: all users. WH_ADMIN: users in same warehouse. TENANT_ADMIN: users in same tenant.

post.description: SYSTEM_ADMIN → WH_ADMIN (warehouseId), TENANT_ADMIN (tenantId). WH_ADMIN → WH_STAFF. TENANT_ADMIN → TENANT_STAFF.
